Mini User Journeys

This was made to imagine needs of people and possible barriers of this webplattform.

!userjourney_wrede.png

!userjourney_nacken.png

!userjourney_toni.png

My Problem with those user journeys is that they seam quite fictional. How can I know that these are some real questions, emotions and barriers they go through? Without testing with users, I can't. That's one of the reasons I don't like the User Journey and Persona methods that much. But I have to admit that I have asked myself some important questions in the process of creating those. That is good.
